metaDescription: Order custom Gotrays sun visor clips for your brand. Perfect for bulk orders. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Gotrays sun visor clips offer a durable, practical way to keep your brand visible in vehicles every day. Made from strong plastic with a spring-loaded design, these clips securely hold sunglasses, documents, or parking passes on a car's sun visor. Choose from popular shapes like the Ad Clip or Oval Clip, and customize with your logo using screen printing or pad printing. Ideal for corporate giveaways, safety incentives, or dealership promotions.
